principles: Reaction-function theory and empirical evidence are separate layers.
No universal G8 transmission score is assumed.
Front-end and price confirmation may alter interpretation but cannot override the macro bias mechanically.
Evidence labels are descriptive research states, not production weights or gates.
WITHHELD is mandatory where PIT/OOS evidence is insufficient.

evidence_labels.SUPPORTED_DIAGNOSTIC: There is OOS evidence of economically coherent transmission, but not sufficient proof for a production gate.
evidence_labels.PROMISING_SMALL_SAMPLE: Direction is encouraging but sample size is too small for robust use.
evidence_labels.NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE: The tested confirmation layer does not improve the macro signal reliably OOS.
evidence_labels.WITHHELD: Evidence is not yet sufficient or not yet tested on comparable certified PIT data.

USD.front_end_role: Transmission/context, strongest evidence in coherent dovish/easing regimes
USD.interpretation: Fed easing transmission is the clearest validated diagnostic channel so far; tightening confirmation is weaker and should not be scored symmetrically.

CAD.front_end_role: Useful only conditionally; not a standalone gate
CAD.interpretation: When the macro/inflation state is internally coherent, common-core confirmation improves directionally, but the sample remains too small for promotion.

GBP.primary_macro_state: Wages + services inflation, with labour as context
GBP.interpretation: BoE OIS/front-end confirmation does not improve the coherent macro state OOS and can be misleading if converted into a conviction score.

JPY.interpretation: JGB 2Y and relative-rate transmission are economically meaningful but do not justify a mechanical conviction upgrade OOS.

EUR.interpretation: Existing wages+2Y walk-forward does not establish robust incremental value from front-end confirmation.

AUD.interpretation: Reaction-function logic is defined, but comparable PIT/OOS transmission evidence is not yet certified.

NZD.interpretation: Comparable PIT/OOS transmission evidence is not yet certified.

CHF.primary_macro_state: Inflation forecast + economic conditions + exchange-rate channel
CHF.interpretation: A simple rates confirmation framework is structurally incomplete for the SNB because the exchange rate is itself part of the policy transmission mechanism.

cross_currency_conclusion.preferred_architecture: Macro state -> currency-specific central-bank reaction function -> front-end/relative-rates transmission -> price confirmation -> qualitative transmission state
